job.job_description:
Gen AI - Engineer
Location: Noida, UP, India
Job Description
Strong hands-on experience in Python (production-grade development)
Experience in building and deploying Generative AI / LLM-based solutions
Strong knowledge of RAG architecture and LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain or similar)
Experience with vector databases and embeddings
Advanced SQL (complex queries, performance optimization)
Experience developing APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
Working knowledge of OpenShift (OCP) and containerization (Docker)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
Good to Have
Experience with model fine-tuning
Exposure to cloud AI services (Azure/AWS/GCP)
Understanding of MLOps practices
Experience in banking/insurance domain
We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer capable of independently designing and delivering end-to-end GenAI solutions. The role requires strong Python and SQL expertise, hands-on experience with LLMs and RAG architectures, and working knowledge of OpenShift-based deployments. The candidate should be able to:
Design and build scalable GenAI solutions
Develop and optimize RAG pipelines
Build APIs and integrate structured/unstructured data sources
Deploy solutions on OCP with minimal supervision
Take ownership from design to production
The expectation is that after initial onboarding, the resource should be able to work independently with minimal guidance
Mandatory Competencies
Database - Database Programming - SQL
DevOps/Configuration Mgmt - DevOps/Configuration Mgmt - Docker
Data AI - GEN AI - Python
Cloud Containers - Container Platform (PaaS) - OpenShift
Data Science and Machine Learning - Data Science and Machine Learning - NLP (Natural language processing)
Artificial Intelligence - AI Tools - GitHub Copilot
